items.title: Moderna secures up to 24 million RSV vaccine dose contract with Europe
items.summary: Over 156,000 adults in Europe are hospitalised each year due to RSV, a virus that can cause severe lung issues.

items.title: Sino and AstraZeneca sign licence agreement for TQC3721
items.summary: AstraZeneca and Sino Biopharmaceutical's subsidiary CTTQ have signed an exclusive licence agreement for TQC3721.

items.title: Evogene and Tel Aviv University launch drug discovery initiative
items.summary: Evogene and Tel Aviv University’s BCDD have partnered to expedite small-molecule drug discovery originating from Israeli academic research.

items.title: FDA cracks down on illegal ketamine sellers amid nearing ‘psychedelic revolution’
items.summary: The FDA is taking action to curb the illicit online trade of unregulated and unapproved ketamine products through a slew of warning letters.

items.title: Kalohexis confidentially files IPO to back obesity and cachexia portfolio
items.summary: The biotech’s potential launch on the public markets would help fuel development of its clinical-stage, melanocortin-focused pipeline.
